title: DynaKit – Maintenance
description:
DynaKit – Maintenance
The Maintenance DynaKit will help keep your vapcap clean and functioning as intended. It comes with DynaWax to lubricate o-rings and rejuvenate wood parts. Along with all o-rings used in vapcaps and some hard bristled pipe cleaners to help clean out condensers.
Included
1 x DynaWax
3 x Condenser O-rings
5 x High Temp O-rings
5 x Cotton Pipe Cleaners
